# proxmox_cluster_bulk_action (Resource)

Runs a cluster-wide bulk action (`start`, `shutdown`, `suspend`, `migrate`) on a set of guests through `POST /cluster/bulk-action/guest/{action}` and waits for the bulk worker. Every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_cluster_bulk_action" "start_all" {
  action   = "start"
  vms      = [300, 301]
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Bulk action: `start`, `shutdown`, `suspend` or `migrate`.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to run the action again.
- `vms` (Set of Number) Guest VMIDs the action applies to.

### Optional

- `max_workers` (Number) Maximum concurrent tasks for `start` and `migrate` (1-64).
- `online` (Boolean) Live migration for VMs, restart migration for containers.
- `target` (String) Target node, required for `migrate`.
- `with_local_disks` (Boolean) Migrate local disks as well.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<action>/<vmid,>` form.
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID.
